access.label: How We Start
access.title: BUILT
access.intro: We don't open with a heavy retainer. We start small, prove the intelligence works, and only scale what's proven.

step1.name: Intelligence Sprint
step1.desc: 25–30 account intelligence briefs on your ideal targets — the signals we detected, the decision-makers behind them, and the outreach angle we recommend for each one.
step1.note: Backed by a 30-day money-back guarantee: if the briefs don't sharpen your pipeline, you get a full refund.

step2.name: Activation Pilot
step2.desc: A scoped outbound campaign on the accounts from your sprint, with success metrics agreed before we start.

step3.name: Acquisition Infrastructure
step3.desc: Continuous signal monitoring, new accounts every month, activation and reporting — a system that compounds over time.
step3.note: One client per vertical and territory. While you're in, your competitors aren't.

access.ctaNote: Every engagement starts with a 30-minute conversation.

founder.label: Who's Behind This
founder.title: Built by an Operator
founder.subtitle: Intelinx was created by someone who has built, scaled, and sold across industries — and now applies AI to the hardest part of growth: finding the right clients at the right time.
founder.role: Founder & AI Systems Architect · Montreal, Canada
founder.bio: After two decades of building and scaling businesses — managing teams, growing revenue, figuring out what makes people buy — I realized the hardest part was always the same: finding the right conversation with the right person at the right time. So I built a system that does exactly that. Intelinx is what I wish I'd had from day one.

finalCta.title: Ready to turn client acquisition into structured infrastructure?
